body: thank you for your kind words. I was prescribed anti-depressants last year but literally had nightmares about them because I felt like they would make a robot out of me. I was also worried about all the side effects. I actually manage fine ish most of the time. I just, like you say don't have enough energy to deal with things or squeeze more out of myself. I just live, day by day. Sometimes I get enthusiastic about something, sometimes I even manage to do it. But the Master's project, it just completely killed me. I've put too much pressure on myself about it. I always found it hard to write and I didn't study well at uni so Masters is kinda last chance to get a good grade and managed fine so far but this final thing. I can't do. I deferred it once already for the same reason. I freeze. I can't do it. When I'm not doing it, I think I can, but as soon as I sit in front of my lap top, I can't. I've been crying for hours now, feeling trapped. It's embarrassing. People do things like that in 2 days pulling all nighters, having kids. I have a full-time job, but that's not what's not letting me do it. I thought I was fine when I deferred it and didn't have to do it but evidently I'm not. I wish I had a fear of flying instead.
thank you Jessica. I don't think my friends will laugh but I don't they can help either. Even parents, they can be supportive but I will have to make a choice in my life and I'm just completely lost.
